architecture_revision: 2026-05-16 — pivoted from single-rubric demo to four-layer composition + separate public pocket-mentor-rubrics repo. See SPEC §11 decisions log entries dated 2026-05-15 / 2026-05-16.

RubricFetcher + EnrichmentLoader + RubricParser will be retired or refactored.

features.name: Async-race enrichment YAML (legacy format)

features.name: Generic parametrised mech-checkers
features.description: Registry pattern: each checker is (prContext, criterion) => Violation[]. Eight generic parametrised checkers configured via YAML checker_config.
features.evidence: commits a710b33..d5d2439; 8 generic parametrised checkers in registry (dep-presence, eslint-rule-configured, forbidden-imports, html-body-allowed-tags, package-scripts-match, eslint-plugin-presence, typescript-any-usage, magic-numbers-scan); ./init.sh green; code-reviewer subagent ran
features.carryover_under_new_architecture: Fully reused. The combined YAML's checker_id + checker_config references resolve to the same checker functions. No checker code changes needed.

features.name: Format migration: combined-YAML + RubricLoader + pocket-mentor-rubrics repo
features.description: Create separate public pocket-mentor-rubrics repo. Define combined-YAML Zod schema (criteria + check config + optional applies_when + optional penalty in one file). Implement RubricLoader (replaces RubricFetcher + EnrichmentLoader). Author starter rubrics: common-review.yaml, react.yaml, stage2/async-race.yaml. Add _template.yaml + CONTRIBUTING.md.
features.notes: First step: stand up pocket-mentor-rubrics repo (public, README documents layer model). Then schema. Then loader. Then author the three starter rubrics — content lift, not engine code.

features.name: Layer composition: StackDetector + RubricComposer + overrides
features.description: StackDetector reads student package.json, evaluates applies_when of each layer-2 stack rubric. RubricComposer merges layers 1+2+3+4 with override / disable / additional_criteria semantics. Overrides loader for ~/.pocket-mentor/overrides.yaml (may be missing — handle gracefully).
features.notes: Override conflict-resolution edge cases (disable inside hybrid pair, points_max overrides) need spec'ing during implementation. See SPEC §12.

features.name: LLM orchestrator + aggregator + output calibration
features.description: Prompt composer (criterion + diff slice + llm_focus + level-specific template — junior/standard/senior controlling tone, length, mandatory before/after example, no jargon). Vercel AI SDK client (Claude default, OpenRouter fallback) with retries, Zod validation. Aggregator merges mech + llm violations, filters by --level (severity threshold), enforces review_limits caps with '+N similar' summary on overflow, applies layer-3 penalties (Stage 2 deadline miss, no cross-check), produces Output schema. Summary generator picks top-3 highest-impact violations for the review body header. CLI flag --level=junior|standard|senior plumbed end-to-end (default junior).
deferred_from_m1: llm/client.ts: LLMResponse.stopReason — type as string or FinishReason (currently string | null, SDK never returns null)
features.calibration_notes: Severity field already exists in types.ts (ViolationSeverity). review_limits is a new optional block in common-review.yaml. LLM template must produce ≤3 sentences with before/after snippet. External links only via YAML reference: field (not LLM-invented). Rationale: strict rubric finds 40+ issues in beginner code; without triage students disengage.

features.name: GitHub draft delivery + CLI + smoke test
features.description: GitHubDeliverer (Octokit, event: PENDING, multi-line comment handling). CLI commands: init wizard (token + LLM key + clone rubrics repo + create overrides), review <pr-url> [--task <id>] [--rubrics-source <url>] [--as-draft | --output json | --output markdown], rubrics sync, overrides edit. Smoke test against HelgaZhizhka/pocket-mentor-test-fixtures for BOTH flat mode (React) and --task mode (Stage 2 async-race).
features.notes: no-console eslint override needed for packages/cli at this point. Helga to create pocket-mentor-test-fixtures private repo before smoke test.
